The '''Black Bantha Nebula''' was a dangerous gas cloud formation inside the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]. A slowly-condensing [[Protostar/Legends|protostar]], it was usually misidentified as a [[Gamma Class navigation hazard]]. It was the site where the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] forces [[Battle of the Black Bantha|amassed]] before their [[Battle of Coruscant (Yuuzhan Vong War)|invasion]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].
